parts:
Hey guys,

I have a question regarding the format of the files uploaded to shiny. The file I was playing around is a .xlsx file.  The first row is the header and the first column is the binary class label of "healthy" and "cancer", then I re-saved the file into a csv file (in EXCEL, the available choice is CSV (Comma delimited)). Then I was trying to lode this file to shiny, however, the value of the first column of class label turned into "0" and "-0" and my program is unable to display and analyze the uploaded file properly. Anyone knows how to deal with this?

Thank you,

Su
